title: Riff Rooftop Rush
description: Endless rooftop survival! Riff switches lanes with up/down and hops with A. Catch notes for trick points; jumping earns no free points. Dodge low speakers and stay grounded under high drones. Hazards accelerate each 20-second wave. Four hearts. F fullscreen. Windows installer available. Clean gameplay HUD; sunset skate city art direction.
